baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative verb at word 2 governs the pasture noun at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Causative extraction converts vegetation that was latent or enclosed into an accessible field of grazing.

activation_trace.role: Causing a hidden thing to emerge supplies the transition from latent growth to visible availability.
Grazing-place and fodder identify the emerged object as usable sustenance rather than vegetation in the abstract.

changed_reading.before: The agent simply makes pasture exist.
changed_reading.after: The agent draws a grazing resource out of concealment and makes it available to consumers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The output verb and the semantic range of the pasture noun meet in the direct-object construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pasture can be carried as an issued yield inside a relation of care: something is brought out because dependents must be maintained.

activation_trace.role: A due output or yield supplies the image of provision issued in a determinate form.
Shepherding and custodial preservation turn the yield into maintenance of beings under care.

changed_reading.before: Pasture is a piece of natural scenery.
changed_reading.after: Pasture is a provisioned yield issued within a custodial economy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The eventive emergence at word 2 is qualified by the outcome-aware range of the noun's root at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Emergence is not isolated from what follows it; the pasture is a process whose condition and outcome invite observation.

activation_trace.role: Passing out from within supplies the initial phase of a trajectory.
Watching an affair and considering its outcome makes the pasture's later condition part of how its emergence is read.

changed_reading.before: The verse records one moment of botanical appearance.
changed_reading.after: The verse opens an observed pasture-trajectory whose end belongs to the meaning of its beginning.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A color-patch branch of the verb's root remains attached to the literal grazing field.
baseline_models.mechanism: What is brought forth may be imagined not as a uniform carpet but as a visibly differentiated land surface, alternating growth with exposed or differently colored ground.

activation_trace.role: Two-color patchiness supplies a mottled spatial pattern for the act of bringing forth.
Literal pasture keeps the color-pattern activation anchored in an actual grazing landscape.

changed_reading.before: Pasture appears as a homogeneous green mass.
changed_reading.after: Pasture emerges as a differentiated, patch-like surface whose contrasts are already perceptible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding relative clauses place pasture emergence at the end of a chain of nurture, measured formation, completion, bounded apportionment, and gentle direction. The field is therefore an engineered provision-system, not an accidental aftereffect.

activation_trace.role: Hidden-to-visible extraction supplies the final delivery step in the system.
Custodial care identifies the system's beneficiary relation.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply continuous tending rather than a single productive instant.
Measuring and proportioning supply a designed scale for the emerging resource.
Integrity and completion supply a fitted, functioning condition.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit supplies bounded quantity and timing.
Gentle direction toward a way supplies routing between provision and the lives that use it.

structural_cues: 87:1-4 retains one relative-clause subject while moving through forming, apportioning, directing, and bringing forth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurture, measure, completion, direction, extraction, and care; I infer that these are stages of one provision-system. A live alternative is that the clauses list independent acts without specifying a biological causal chain.

changed_reading.before: Pasture is one item among created things.
changed_reading.after: Pasture is the delivered output of a calibrated and directed economy of care.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dominant name branch supplies indication, the non-dominant mark branch supplies rain that marks earth with plants, and the scroll branch supplies a broad written surface. Pasture emergence can therefore coexist with a reading of vegetation as a visible name-mark written across land.

activation_trace.role: Making the hidden visible supplies the disclosure of the mark.
Literal pasture gives the proposed inscription a vegetal material.
A name as indication supplies the signifying function of the vegetation.
The first rain marking earth with plants supplies the concrete vegetal mark from a non-dominant mapped root.
The repeated name-as-indication branch reactivates the signifying frame later in the sequence.
Breadth and spread supply the land-like surface on which the mark appears.
A written sheet turns that spread surface into an inspectable record.

structural_cues: The name occurs at 87:1 and 87:15, while written sheets enter at 87:18-19, surrounding the pasture with sign and record language.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies name-as-indication, rain-as-vegetal-mark, and written surface; I infer that emerging pasture functions like an inscription. A live alternative is that the non-dominant mark mapping is only a remote lexical activator and that the scrolls have no material relation to the land.

changed_reading.before: The pasture is chiefly food brought into existence.
changed_reading.after: The pasture also becomes a rain-written sign made visible on the earth's surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately following transformation turns the same emerged pasture into dark, negligible stubble. Bringing forth is thus phase one of a governed material cycle whose terminal conversion is as intentional as its growth.

activation_trace.role: Emergence from within supplies the cycle's visible beginning.
Watching an affair toward its outcome keeps the end state attached to the pasture noun.
Making a thing enter another state supplies intentional phase conversion.
Pasture becoming brittle stubble supplies the material endpoint and preserves referential continuity.
Blackness or red tending to black supplies the endpoint's darkened visual state.

structural_cues: The prefixed sequence from 87:4 to 87:5 and the object pronoun in 87:5 carry the pasture forward into its changed state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, explicit state-making, pasture-to-stubble, and dark coloration; I infer one governed lifecycle. A live alternative is that the dark color marks a dense or differently staged vegetation state, so the exact boundary between flourishing and decay remains open.

changed_reading.before: Bringing forth pasture is a stable image of increase.
changed_reading.after: Bringing forth pasture initiates a deliberately bounded cycle that includes depletion and dark residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Literal pasture feeds grazing bodies, while the attentive-hearing branch of its root allows an analogical second track: recitation is brought forth for reception, must resist forgetting through reminder, and becomes nourishment only when it benefits.

activation_trace.role: Causing concealed material to emerge supplies the delivery of something available for uptake.
Fodder and grazing supply the bodily nourishment side of the analogy.
Lending attentive hearing supplies the receptive act that links pasture semantics to recitation.
Reading, reciting, and causing recitation supply the offered cognitive material.
Loss of remembrance supplies the failure mode in which offered material is not retained.
A reminder that causes recollection supplies renewed presentation after threatened loss.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the criterion that reception has become effective nourishment.

structural_cues: 87:6-10 moves from caused recitation through non-forgetting and reminder to benefit and responsive recollection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pasture-as-fodder, attentive hearing, recitation, forgetting, reminder, and benefit; I infer a feeding analogy between bodily and cognitive uptake. A live alternative keeps pasture wholly ecological and treats the later sequence as parallel rather than as an activated sense of 87:4.

changed_reading.before: The brought-forth resource feeds only grazing animals.
changed_reading.after: Alongside literal fodder, the verse can model brought-forth recitation as material that must be attentively received, retained, and made beneficial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The visible-hidden antithesis sharpens the verb into disclosure: pasture crosses from concealed potential into public appearance while remaining within knowledge before, during, and after that crossing.

activation_trace.role: Extraction from hiddenness supplies the movement between the two epistemic poles.
Visible grazing growth supplies a concrete result of disclosure.
A thing's disclosure to the knower supplies encompassing cognition across the transition.
Appearance plainly to the eye supplies the public endpoint of growth.
Covering and concealment supply the latent starting condition.

structural_cues: 87:7 places the overt and the hidden in a compact opposition after 87:4 has already enacted a hidden-to-visible verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, ocular manifestation, knowledge, and extraction from hiding; I infer that pasture growth materially stages that relation. A live alternative is that 87:7 states an epistemic totality without identifying the pasture as its demonstration.

changed_reading.before: Pasture emergence is only a biological production event.
changed_reading.after: Pasture emergence is also an enacted crossing from hidden potential to manifest order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opposed branches of dead land and land made alive by rain and plants turn the pasture into the visible criterion of terrestrial revival. Its emergence is the earth passing from inert capacity into living productivity.

activation_trace.role: Passing outward supplies the observable transition into active life.
Pasture supplies the plant life by which revived ground becomes perceptible and useful.
Dead land or spiritless property supplies the inert substrate before growth.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the explicit material reversal of dead land.

structural_cues: 87:13 holds death and life in a negated suspension, activating the opposite, completed transition already visible in 87:4.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dead ground and earth revived by rain and plants; I infer that the emerging pasture is the completed transition between them. A live alternative is that 87:13 concerns a person's punitive state and contributes only an analogy to the ecological scene.

changed_reading.before: Vegetation is added to an otherwise neutral landscape.
changed_reading.after: The emerging pasture is the earth's passage from dead capacity into living, useful productivity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Branches of splitting earth, the farmer who does that work, and increasing growth activate a cultivation sequence beneath the focus verb: ground opens, shoots pass outward, and pasture increases.

activation_trace.role: Passing out from within supplies shoots crossing the opened ground.
Pasture supplies the cultivated result while retaining the literal ecological anchor.
Splitting and cutting supply the opening of resistant earth.
The farmer who splits the ground supplies the agricultural process rather than success in the abstract.
Increase and growth supply expansion after emergence.

structural_cues: The paired verbs of 87:14 follow the life/death opposition and precede ritual response, allowing material flourishing and human flourishing to resonate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earth-splitting, farming, and growth; I infer the arrow from opened soil through emergence to increasing pasture. A live alternative is that 87:14 uses success and purification morally, so cultivation remains a material analogy rather than an asserted agricultural technique.

changed_reading.before: Pasture appears spontaneously at the surface.
changed_reading.after: Pasture can be seen as flourishing through an opening process: earth is split, growth exits, and the field increases.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pasture's quick conversion into stubble becomes a material instance of the later choice between the near and the delayed, enduring good. The brought-forth yield is real provision, but its value cannot be judged at the green moment alone.

activation_trace.role: A due yield supplies the immediately available good that can attract preference.
Considering an affair's outcome requires reading the yield beyond its present condition.
Pasture becoming stubble supplies an immediate resource whose form does not persist.
Putting one thing first by choice supplies the act of ranking present and future goods.
Nearness supplies the temporal pull of what is presently green and usable.
Delay to a later time supplies the counter-horizon beyond immediate appearance.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies a value test rather than mere duration.
Continuance supplies the endurance criterion that the green pasture itself fails.

structural_cues: The 87:4-5 emergence-to-stubble sequence is later echoed by the paired near-world and later-enduring comparison in 87:16-17.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transient pasture, preference, nearness, delay, benefit, and endurance; I infer that the ecological cycle materializes the later value comparison. A live alternative is that the ethical comparison is independent and that 87:4 remains provision without functioning as a choice-model.

changed_reading.before: The green yield is self-evidently the completed gift.
changed_reading.after: The green yield is a genuine but temporary good whose trajectory trains judgment about nearness, benefit, and endurance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because one context root inventory spans both contact with fire and a plant grazed by camels, while the source occurrence plainly belongs to the fire clause. It remains valid as an activation because the focus explicitly names pasture and the cited plant branch names animal grazing. Render it only as a branch-triggered feed-versus-fuel material analogy, never as a claim that the fire clause lexically means pasture.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The pasture noun at 87:4 word 3 supplies biomass that can be consumed, while the context inventory unexpectedly places grazed plant and burning under one mapped root.

activation_trace.role: Emergence supplies the production of biomass before its later modes of consumption.
Grazing and fodder supply the feed side of the material fork.
A plant grazed by camels unexpectedly repeats the pasture domain inside the fire-root inventory.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the fuel side of the same inventory fold.
Kindled fire supplies actual combustion rather than metaphorical warmth.

changed_reading.before: Brought-forth pasture is biomass only in its role as feed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the same produced biomass stands at a feed-or-fuel fork: it can sustain life through grazing or be consumed by heat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because both weather activators come from non-dominant split mappings of context words used as name and first. It remains unusually well anchored because one branch explicitly gives the first rain marking earth with vegetation, the other gives rain following that marking rain, and the focus names pasture emerging. Render it as an inventory-driven meteorological reconstruction, not as the lexical meaning of either context word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The causative emergence of literal pasture at 87:4 is a plausible material result of the two rain images activated elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Causing hidden growth to appear supplies the botanical result of the proposed rain sequence.
Literal pasture supplies the vegetation produced by the rains.
The first rain marking earth with plants supplies the initiating rainfall.
Rain following the marking rain supplies a second precipitation phase that sustains emergence.

changed_reading.before: The pasture appears without an articulated material precursor.
changed_reading.after: The pasture can be carried as the visible result of a two-rain sequence: earth-marking rain followed by sustaining rain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because color patchiness is a distant branch of the focus verb rather than its ordinary causative sense. It remains anchored in the literal field and is sharpened by the next verse's dark-color branch. Render it as a visual overlay in which phases coexist, not as a replacement translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verb's patchwork branch at word 2 modifies the imagined appearance of the pasture object at word 3.

activation_trace.role: Two-color patchiness supplies simultaneous visual differentiation across the field.
Literal grazing land keeps the pattern attached to a concrete surface.
Blackness or red tending to black supplies the dark phase that interrupts or overlays the green.

changed_reading.before: Emergence and darkening are viewed as cleanly separated moments.
changed_reading.after: The field can be imagined as two-toned, with present growth visibly carrying patches or anticipations of its dark future.

strongest_changes: The pasture shifted from an isolated product to the delivered output of measured nurture, guidance, and care.
87:5 made the emergence inseparable from a governed conversion into dark stubble.
The visible-hidden pair recast botanical growth as disclosure of latent order.
The near-versus-lasting comparison made the pasture cycle a material exercise in judging goods by outcome.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root inventories supported several coexisting scales at once: literal fodder, custodial yield, watched lifecycle, and mottled surface. Split context mappings then produced unusually specific surprises, especially vegetation as a rain-written name-mark, a first-and-following rain sequence, and the pasture/fire feed-versus-fuel fold.
remaining_uncertainties: The inscription, recited-nourishment, and two-rain readings are branch-activated analogies rather than secure lexical senses of the focus construction.
The exact force of the dark color in 87:5 leaves some room between terminal decay, dense vegetation, and visual phase overlap.
The calibrated ecological chain may be causal and integrated, or the repeated clauses may primarily coordinate distinct acts.
